The '''New Republic Defense Force headquarters''' was located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and was the command center of the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]]. It contained a conference hall that could be used to monitor fleet operations from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
